app.name: Outreach OS
app.tagline: A shared sales CRM, team inbox, and booking workspace

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The address changed or you do not have access.

error.title: Could not load
error.description: A network or server error occurred. Please try again.

conflict.title: Concurrent edit conflict
conflict.description: Someone else saved first. Choose which value to keep per field.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in with your workspace account.
login.invalidCredentials: The email or password is incorrect.
login.accountLocked: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
login.csrfInvalid: Security token expired. Please try again.

invite.title: Accept invitation
invite.description: You are joining the workspace as {email}.
invite.invalid: This invite link is expired or invalid.
invite.error: Could not accept the invitation. Please try again.

screens.placeholderDescription: Layout and empty states follow the spec. Real data wiring lands in later tasks.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Review today's replies, approvals, meetings, and delivery state.
dashboard.emptyDescription: New replies, approval requests, upcoming meetings, and unknown deliveries appear here. Observation windows and refresh times are shown per card.

companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Manage companies by relationship stage, owner, and latest permitted activity.
companies.emptyDescription: Add a company or start with an import. Duplicate candidates are reviewed via merge requests.

companyDetail.title: Company detail
companyDetail.description: Summary, contacts, activity, emails, meetings, research, and notes in tabs.
companyDetail.emptyDescription: Pick a company from the list. AI-completed fields without a source are marked unverified.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.description: Names, titles, and per-address verification, send basis, and suppression.
contacts.emptyDescription: Add a contact to manage per-address verification and send basis as separate badges.

contactDetail.title: Contact detail
contactDetail.description: Distinguish address validity from send permission.
contactDetail.emptyDescription: Email format validity and send permission appear as separate badges.

inbox.title: Shared Inbox
inbox.description: Assign and handle conversations in shared mailboxes. Receipt is not delivery.
inbox.emptyDescription: New replies appear here. Mailbox reconnect warnings show as banners.

threadDetail.title: Conversation
threadDetail.description: Read the thread alongside the CRM side panel.
threadDetail.emptyDescription: Other members' replies and new answers surface in real time.

templates.title: Templates
templates.description: Manage subjects, bodies, variable definitions, and per-version usage.
templates.emptyDescription: Required variables, HTML safety, and length limits are checked before freeze.

templateDetail.title: Template detail
templateDetail.description: Per-version body, variables, sample data, and preview.
templateDetail.emptyDescription: New versions never modify existing ones.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.description: Configure goal, audience, sequence, and schedule rules before approval.
campaigns.emptyDescription: Campaigns build in 6 steps. Channels the provider disallows surface a blocking banner.

campaignDetail.title: Campaign detail
campaignDetail.description: Six-step configuration with freeze, approval, and execution state.
campaignDetail.emptyDescription: Review & freeze pins the actual send content and rule hash.
campaignDetail.steps: 1. Goal & channel|2. Audience|3. Sequence|4. Schedule & limits|5. Review & freeze|6. Approval & launch

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.description: Review frozen recipients, rendered content, and policy results.
approvals.emptyDescription: You cannot approve your own request. Expiry, cancellation, and version mismatch are shown.

approvalDetail.title: Approval request
approvalDetail.description: Requester, kind, frozen version, recipients, rendered body, policy results.
approvalDetail.emptyDescription: Approve, reject, comment, or request changes — each decision is recorded.

meetings.title: Meetings
meetings.description: Host, guest, external sync state, and attendance outcome.
meetings.emptyDescription: confirming and unknown states are never shown as confirmed.

meetingTypes.title: Meeting types
meetingTypes.description: Types and durations exposed on public booking links.
meetingTypes.emptyDescription: Create a meeting type to issue a public booking link.

agents.title: Agent center
agents.description: Review runs, tool use, evidence, budget, and pending approvals.
agents.emptyDescription: Failed tools and estimated vs. actual cost are shown separately. Agents can never approve or grant.

agentRunDetail.title: Agent run
agentRunDetail.description: Step-by-step tool calls, evidence, and cost for a run.
agentRunDetail.emptyDescription: Runs stopped by policy show the reason.

imports.title: Imports
imports.description: Validate files, map fields, resolve duplicates — dry-run before commit.
imports.emptyDescription: New addresses default to unconfirmed send basis. Partial success is shown as counts.

importDetail.title: Import detail
importDetail.description: Field mapping, validation errors, and failed-row re-entry.

complianceSuppressions.title: Suppressions
complianceSuppressions.description: Per-address block reasons, basis, revocation, evidence, and history.
complianceSuppressions.emptyDescription: Unsubscribes are scoped per purpose; release requires separate approval.

complianceReviews.title: Basis reviews
complianceReviews.description: Review the validity of per-purpose contact basis.
complianceReviews.emptyDescription: A checkbox alone cannot make consent valid — evidence is reviewed.

operationsJobs.title: Job queue
operationsJobs.description: Operate async jobs, retries, and dead-letter jobs.
operationsJobs.emptyDescription: Unknown outcomes go through investigation, not a resend button.

operationsIntegrations.title: Integrations
operationsIntegrations.description: Mail, calendar, and delivery channel health plus policy reviews.
operationsIntegrations.emptyDescription: OAuth secrets are never displayed. Connections needing reauth are flagged.

settingsMembers.title: Members
settingsMembers.description: Manage members, roles, agent principals, and invitations.
settingsMembers.emptyDescription: Admin-created invite links are shown only once.

settingsMailAccounts.title: Mail accounts
settingsMailAccounts.description: Shared mailbox connections and per-mailbox grants.
settingsMailAccounts.emptyDescription: Mailbox grants distinguish read, compose, send, approve, and assign.

settingsCalendars.title: Calendars
settingsCalendars.description: Per-host calendar connections and sync state.
settingsCalendars.emptyDescription: Connect a calendar to offer public booking slots.

settingsPolicies.title: Policies
settingsPolicies.description: Send basis, retention, channel policies, and emergency stop.
settingsPolicies.emptyDescription: Policy changes apply more strictly to running work.

settingsSecurity.title: Security
settingsSecurity.description: Sessions, service credentials, and audit log access.
settingsSecurity.emptyDescription: Audit logs record allowlisted metadata only.

design.title: Design system
design.description: Dev-only page showcasing ported primitives and Outreach patterns in both themes.
design.emptyDescription: Inspect components in both themes below.

book.title: Book a meeting
book.description: Pick an available time below to request a booking.
book.name: Name
book.footnote: A request is not confirmed immediately; the result is sent by email.
book.error: Could not submit the booking. Please try again.

bookingManage.title: Manage booking
bookingManage.description: Review booking details, reschedule, or cancel.
bookingManage.confirmingNote: Your booking is being confirmed. Refreshing shows the same state.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe
unsubscribe.description: Stop receiving email from this sender organization. Opening this page changes nothing.
unsubscribe.doneDescription: Your request was processed. Already-processed tokens show the same result.
unsubscribe.error: Could not process the request. Please try again.
